# Utils

Small helpers.

## What's here

- `math.js` - Fibonacci and logarithmic number sequences
- `color.js` - distance between two hex colors
- `tailwind/` - the Tailwind color palette as a JS object
- `diagnostics/scroll-blocked.js` - paste into a page to find what is blocking scroll
- `gsap-test.js` - a data-speed parallax test

## How it connects

- The logger the choreography code imports (`utils/lumberjack`) is not in this folder. It is the `@datainkio/lumberjack` package, copied to `assets/js/utils/lumberjack/` at build time.
